groom.definition:
n. a man participant in his own marriage ceremony
n. a man who has recently been married
v. care for one's external appearance
groom.translation:
n. 马夫, 新郎, 男仆
vt. 喂马, 使...整洁, 推荐
vi. 打扮, 穿戴

groombridge.translation: [人名] [英格兰人姓氏] 格鲁姆布里奇住所名称，来源于中世纪英语，含义是“格鲁姆家的桥”(the bridge of the Grooms)

groome.translation: [人名] [英格兰人姓氏] 格鲁姆 Groom的变体

groomed.definition: a. neat and smart in appearance; well cared for

groomer.definition:
n. One who, or that which, grooms horses; especially, a brush
   rotated by a flexible or jointed revolving shaft, for cleaning horses.

groomers.definition:
plural of groomer
n. One who, or that which, grooms horses; especially, a brush
   rotated by a flexible or jointed revolving shaft, for cleaning horses.

groomes.translation: (groome 的复数)  [人名] [英格兰人姓氏] 格鲁姆 Groom的变体

groomings.definition:

grooms.definition:

n. a long narrow furrow cut either by a natural process (such as erosion) or by a tool (as e.g. a groove in a phonograph record)
n. (anatomy) any furrow or channel on a bodily structure or part
v. make a groove in, or provide with a groove
groove.translation:
n. 凹槽, 惯例, 理想境况
vt. 开槽于

grooved.definition: s. established as if settled into a groove or rut
grooved.translation: a. 带纹道的；表面有沟槽的

groovelike.translation: a. 缺乏独创性的,老一套的,墨守成规的

groover.definition: n. a device that makes grooves by cutting or punching

groovers.definition:
-s form of groover
n. a device that makes grooves by cutting or punching
groovers.translation: (groover 的第三人称 -s形式) n. 挖槽者, 挖槽机, 挖槽工具

grooves.definition:
n a long narrow furrow cut either by a natural process (such as erosion) or by a tool (as e.g. a groove in a phonograph record)

n (anatomy) any furrow or channel on a bodily structure or part
v make a groove in, or provide with a groove
v hollow out in the form of a furrow or groove
grooves.translation:
n. 沟( groove的名词复数 ); 槽; 老一套; （某种）音乐节奏
v. 沟( groove的第三人称单数 ); 槽; 老一套; （某种）音乐节奏
